definitions.explanation: Casual spoken variant of {割|わり}と / {割|わり}に, meaning 'fairly' or 'comparatively (more than expected).' Most common in informal conversation.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧、わりかし⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: This shop is fairly cheap, isn't it.

examples.japanese: ⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧わりかし⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧だった。
⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}っていた→降る：00839_furu⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、わりかし⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{着|つ}いた→着く：00680_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: It was raining, but I got there fairly quickly.

notes:
Casual conversational variant of ⟦{割|わり}と→割と：00420_warito⟧ and ⟦{割|わり}→割：03194_wari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧. The し ending gives it a colloquial, slightly old-fashioned or down-to-earth feel. Avoid in formal writing or business contexts.

USAGE:
- Like ⟦{割|わり}と→割と：00420_warito⟧, it expresses 'more than I had expected' — comparing reality to a prior expectation.
- Modifies adjectives, adverbs, and verbs: わりかし⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧, わりかし⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧, わりかし⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{割|わり}と→割と：00420_warito⟧: relatively; fairly — standard form, usable in writing
- ⟦{割|わり}→割：03194_wari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: relatively; fairly — close to ⟦{割|わり}と→割と：00420_warito⟧, slightly more formal feel
- ⟦{結構|けっこう}→結構：10387_kekkou⟧: quite; fairly — similar meaning, broader register
